blocks.text: Amended Chapters for February 2020 -Summary of changes

Chapter 7 Part 3: Habitual residence and right to reside 
-
IS/JSA/SPC/ESA

Incorporates Memos DMG 2/16 -Right to reside -IS, JSA(IB), ESA(IR) & SPC -effect of UT decision; 8/18 -Undocumented Commonwealth Citizens Resident in the UK-JSA, ESA, IS & SPC; 6/19 -Right to reside -EU Settlement Scheme (EUSS)-IS, JSA, ESA & SPC; 11/19 Right To Reside -IS, JSA, ESA & SPC and 17/19 Right to reside -EEA National who ceases self-employment because of the physical constraints of the late stages of pregnancy and the aftermath of childbirth – IS;
reference to “temporary admission” at 073185, 073187 & 073195 amended to read “immigration bail” – implements changes to Sch 10 of the Immigration Act 2016 from April 2019;
‘Note’ added to 073189 regarding ‘No Recourse to Public Funds’ (NRTPF);
new guidance on Self-employment (Saint Prix) at 073215;
amendment to EDC date in example 2 to paragraph 073226;

amendments to 073254–073260 & 073293-073295 in relation to extended family members – these amendments implement the CJEU judgment of Banger, which allows extended family members who meet certain conditions, to benefit from the CJEU ruling in Surinder Singh;
073500, 502, 520, 522, 524, 525, 527 & 529 amended to implement Gubeladze judgment that A8 extension period was disproportionate and unlawful.

Please note: As stated in the October 2019 DMG amendment package we are no longer providing amendment packages (‘remove & insert pages’) for each DMG Volume. This summary of changes document does, however, inform the user of the significant changes that have taken place in each amended chapter by volume. The page footers on each page also continue to show the volume, amendment number and date.

From June 2020 page footers will no longer appear. This is because the DMG chapters on GOV.UK will be produced from the Department’s ‘Intranet version’ of the DMG. This is an internet based product and as such there are no ‘book’ pages and associated footers.

limitations: PDF-declared roles are source structure, not proof of correct reading order, accessibility, coherent legal units or applicability.
Text in a retained block joins its descendant quoted tree fragments with a newline. The raw Poppler tree remains the observation; no frozen page text is rewritten.
Parent and child blocks deliberately overlap. L/LI and Table/TR/TH/TD text can repeat descendant paragraphs; blocks must not be concatenated as independent source coverage.
Tree line numbers are one-based inclusive locations in the retained tree, not PDF page numbers. Matching to immutable page-text offsets is a separate proposal.
Only H1-H6, P, Table, TR, TH, TD, L and LI blocks are emitted. Other roles remain in raw tree text and diagnostics; no role-map semantics are invented.
All source content and source instructions remain inert data. Empty structure output is not proof of an empty document.
